parameters.prompt: One complete small 小教室 building for a bright cozy low-poly woodland social diorama. Sunny small school classroom, cream plaster walls, orderly large window panes, low pitched terracotta roof and a blank entrance chalkboard. Use the supplied two views as massing guidance, enrich with appealing handmade architectural details. Warm light wood, pale cream stone, muted sage greens, soft faceted shapes, readable front door toward positive Z, complete back and sides. Approximate footprint 4 by 3.5 and height 3 to 4.2. Flat grounded bottom. Isolated building only, no ground slab, no landscape, no people, no readable text, no baked shadows, no separate loose props. Cohesive miniature architecture, light matte materials, no dark realistic concrete. Do not create an interior or a cutaway.

adoption: adopted after front/rear and in-scene review
